title: IXTK90N25L2 / IXTX90N25L2 Linear L2 Power MOSFET w/ Extended FBSOA, 250 V, 90 A, <36 mOhm, DS100080A(4/16)
method: Table values copied from the datasheet text with a fetch tool (no curve digitized). Distributor-hosted copy of the IXYS PDF (Chip and Dip; pages stamped 'Downloaded from Arrow.com'); no Advance/Preliminary marking. The official littelfuse.com product page renders by script and gave no datasheet link to the fetch tool. I_D at T_C = 100 C is not tabulated (Fig. 6 curve only) -> null. R_DS(on) = 36 mOhm at V_GS = 10 V, I_D = 0.5 I_D25 (header '< 36 mOhm', so a maximum). The min/typ/max column of R_thJC and of the SOA row could not be confirmed from the extracted text. FBSOA Fig. 13 (T_C = 25 C) and Fig. 14 (T_C = 75 C) with 25 us, 100 us, 1 ms, 10 ms, 100 ms and DC lines and the Z_thJC Fig. 12 are graph-only and were not read. Check: 75 C + 575 W x 0.13 C/W = 149.8 C = T_JM, so the 5 s point is the steady-state limit. An older preliminary copy (DS100080(11/08), https://static.chipdip.ru/lib/700/DOC011700854.pdf) states 33 mOhm and the same SOA row.

ratings.R_DSon_note: max, V_GS = 10 V, I_D = 0.5 I_D25, pulse test
